type Chan = { cap: int, items: List[int] }

make_chan(cap: int) -> Chan =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out.cap == cap
  ex make_chan(3).cap == 3
  Chan(cap: cap, items: [])

try_send(var ch: Chan, v: int) -> bool uses nondet =
  post ch.items.len() <= ch.cap
  if ch.items.len() >= ch.cap
    return False
  ch.items = ch.items + [v]
  True

accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2, 3]) == 0
  var ch = make_chan(cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    if try_send(&ch, x)
      n += 1
    else
      break
  n

test_accepted() =
  assert accepted(0, [1, 2, 3]) == 0
  assert accepted(2, [1, 2, 3]) == 2
  assert accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
